description: Four colossal seated figures with striped headdresses are carved into a tan sandstone cliff beside a wide river with sailing boats and green banks. Small figures stand on wooden scaffolds and ladders and work around the statues' feet and laps. Hieroglyph-like carvings cover the cliff face, and a shadowed doorway opens between the statues' feet. The scene is a painting of stone carving, with no frame.
